crossRefs.note: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says…
Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.
For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of…
Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be, unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is…
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

translations.web: “Yahweh says, ‘Don’t deceive yourselves, saying, “The Chaldeans will surely depart from us;” for they will not depart.
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD says: Do not deceive yourselves by saying, ‘The Chaldeans will go away for good,’ for they will not!
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.
translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah, Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us; for they shall not depart.
